class.name: AccessibilitySettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [AccessibilitySettingsServer]: UI scale, font size, color scheme, focus outline, spoken focus, reduced motion, colorblind mode and subtitles.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"accessibility"[/code]. [AccessibilitySettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/accessibility.ini[/code]. Change the values through [AccessibilitySettingsServer] or [method SettingsServer.set_value], not on the resource, so that they are validated and applied. [member ui_scale], [member font_size_factor], [member color_scheme], [member custom_color_scheme_path], [member focus_outline_width], [member speak_focused_controls] and [member speech_persona] reach the engine (root window, its theme, [TTSServer]). [member reduce_motion], [member reduce_transparency], [member colorblind_mode], [member subtitles_enabled], [member captions_enabled] and [member subtitle_scale] are game-side values: the engine stores them, and the game applies them. It can also be used as the project defaults of the domain: save an [AccessibilitySettings] as a [code].tres[/code] file and name it in the project setting [code]settings/defaults/accessibility[/code].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], subtitles include closed captions (sounds, reactions, music, lyrics, see [method SubtitleSegment.is_caption]); if [code]false[/code], they show speech only. Only applies while [member subtitles_enabled] is on. Game-side: [SubtitleLabel] follows it; [member SubtitleServer.captions_enabled] is the separate switch of the subtitle tracks.

The color scheme of the GUI, an [enum AccessibilitySettingsServer.ColorScheme] value. Any other value than [constant AccessibilitySettingsServer.COLOR_SCHEME_DEFAULT] overlays text, selection and focus colors and the flat style boxes of the built-in controls. The default is [constant AccessibilitySettingsServer.COLOR_SCHEME_HIGH_CONTRAST_DARK] if the OS asks for more contrast ([method DisplayServer.accessibility_should_increase_contrast]).
The color vision deficiency of the player, an [enum AccessibilitySettingsServer.ColorblindMode] value. Game-side: the engine applies no filter; the game picks distinguishable colors or icons for it.

The path of an [AccessibilityColorScheme] resource ([code]res://[/code] or [code]user://[/code]) used with [constant AccessibilitySettingsServer.COLOR_SCHEME_CUSTOM]. A path that is not such a resource prints a warning, and no colors are overlaid.
The width of the focus outline of the built-in controls, in pixels. [code]0[/code] keeps the theme's own [code]focus[/code] style box (or the one of the color scheme).

The factor of the GUI font size. The overlay theme gets the base font size (of the root window's theme, the project theme or [member ThemeDB.fallback_font_size]) times this factor as its default font size, and the explicit font sizes of the built-in types times this factor. Use [method AccessibilitySettingsServer.scale_font_size] for sizes the game sets itself.

If [code]true[/code], the player wants less motion: no or shorter animations, no camera shake, no parallax. Game-side; see [method AccessibilitySettingsServer.get_animation_duration] and [method AccessibilitySettingsServer.get_motion_scale]. The default follows [method DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_animation].
If [code]true[/code], the player wants opaque panels instead of transparent or blurred ones. Game-side. The default follows [method DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_transparency].

If [code]true[/code], the control that gets the focus in the root window is spoken with [TTSServer] (see [method AccessibilitySettingsServer.get_control_speech_text]). Skipped while a screen reader is active.
The name of the [TTSPersona] registered in [TTSServer] that speaks the focused controls. Empty or unknown: the default persona of [TTSServer].
The size factor of subtitles. Game-side; see [method AccessibilitySettingsServer.scale_subtitle_font_size].
If [code]true[/code], the game shows subtitles. Game-side.
The scale of the whole GUI. Multiplies [member Window.content_scale_factor] of the root window, together with the factor of [WindowSettingsServer].
